name: qwen3.8-27b-bf16-pro6000ws-256k-bf16kv-mtp2
notes: Full-precision RTX PRO 6000 WS profile for Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B: bfloat16 model weights and bfloat16 KV cache (no quantization), 256K context, MTP n=2 (method 'mtp' per vLLM >=0.21 naming), copied from the tested qwen3.6 pro6000ws bf16kv method (max_num_seqs=8, max_num_batched_tokens=16384, max_new_tokens=32768, prefix caching). gpu_memory_utilization 0.92 matches the 2026-08-15 RTX PRO 6000 benchmark stack. Known tradeoff (measured on this GPU): MTP gives ~2.3x decode at short context but collapses to ~16-19 t/s at 200K context vs ~40-44 t/s without MTP. max_num_seqs=8 keeps the GDN linear-attention state cache well under bounds (default 1024 overflows). Repo is ~55.6 GB BF16 (18 shards) and must be transferred with --stream; do not stage locally. Runs on vLLM v0.27.1 image; requires transformers >= 5.8.0 (verify at smoke test).
